summary.text: Daniel Darris-O'Connor is the Democratic candidate for the Massachusetts House of Representatives, 22nd Middlesex District, in the November 3, 2026 general election, running against incumbent Republican Marc Lombardo.
In a Ballotpedia survey, he described himself as a lifelong Billerica resident who works in the aviation industry and has served on the Billerica Select Board.

paragraphs.text: Daniel Darris-O'Connor earned a high school diploma from Billerica Memorial High School.

In a Ballotpedia survey, he said his path to public service began during the pandemic, when he got involved in state-level campaigns and served as a student representative on the Billerica School Committee.

He later ran for the Select Board, and he said his work there included helping recruit a new town manager, assistant town manager and town legal counsel, casting a tie-breaking vote on water infrastructure investments, and supporting budgets that fully fund the public works, police and fire departments.
Darris-O'Connor said in the survey that he would press for Billerica's share of state funding and work to lower the cost of living for working families and seniors.
He also listed the local economy, health care, education and government accountability among his priorities.
